summary: The exact-target matrix [[2,1,1],[1,2,1],[1,1,2]] has eigenvalues {4,1,1}. In dimension three, any three nonempty disjoint scalar banks are singletons, and nonzero bank rescaling/permutation preserves nonzero diagonal and off-diagonal entries. Therefore an exhaustive reduction that first forces the special arrowhead zero pattern U^2=UZ=0 is false. This does not refute QFORM: QFORM-THREE-BANK-GENERAL-CORE-v1 gives density <36 for this matrix and arbitrary independent cap-one input laws.
